description: Let \(M_n\) be a sequence of first-order structures with compatible embeddings between stages. Suppose given injective coherent maps \(j_n:M_n\to U\) jointly cover a set \(U\). Then \(U\) admits a structure making every specified \(j_n\) an embedding. No structure on \(U\) is assumed.
signature:

  [(n : ℕ) → L.Structure (G n)] (f : (i j : ℕ) → i ≤ j → L.Embedding (G i) (G j))
  [DirectedSystem G fun i j h => ⇑(f i j h)] {U : Type w'} (j : (n : ℕ) → G n ↪ U)
  (hcompat : ∀ (a b : ℕ) (h : a ≤ b) (x : G a), (j b) ((f a b h) x) = (j a) x)
  (hcover : ∀ (x : U), ∃ n a, (j n) a = x) : ∃ S, ∀ (n : ℕ), ∃ e, ⇑e = ⇑(j n)
